name: software-workflows
description: Agent-teams orchestration with Codex as the cross-model advisor and writer: the Codex Oracle MCP server (architect_review, code_review, research, codex_query, abraham and its run tools) and the hooks that gate plan mode and git push on a Codex review.

office.title: Codex Office: when to show it
office.description: The Codex Office is the live pixel view of your Codex runs, in your browser at http://127.0.0.1:8765/; watching it costs no tokens. open (default): start it the first time a session uses a Codex tool, and open it in your browser once per session. background: start it the same way, but never open the browser. off: never start it automatically; /software-workflows:office still starts it. The SOFTWARE_WORKFLOWS_OFFICE environment variable, when set, overrides this for the sessions that have it.
